newsitem.title: NORWAY: Transocean announces sale of non-core asset.
newsitem.headline: Transocean announces sale of non-core asset.

text.p: Transocean Offshore Inc said on Wednesday a Norwegian underwriting syndicate has been established to effect the sale of the group's non-core activities and assets held in a newly-formed entity known as Procon Offshore ASA.
The company had previously announced that it planned to divest certain non-core activities and associated assets within its drilling serivces line of business.
In a statement to the Oslo bourse, Transocean said the underwriting syndicate had established a total market value for Procon of 810 million crowns.
Shares in Procon will be offered for public sale in Norway between May 7 and 20, with a listing on the Oslo bourse to following early June.
Transocean said the members of the underwriting group had agreed to purchase any Procon shares not sold to the public.
